notes: Camera-only I/O shown; the optional bundled speaker connects via a proprietary 4-pin cable to the camera's Audio Output terminal block and is not modeled as a separate generic port. The camera has no built-in HDMI port — HDMI video comes from the connected computer's UC client, and an optional external "HDMI audio embedder" accessory (third-party accessory, not part of the camera) can embed far-end audio into that HDMI path; this was excluded since it is not a physical port on the device itself. Power is delivered entirely via PoE+ over the Network RJ-45 port (25W); there is no separate AC/DC power inlet on the camera. EasyMic ports are RJ-45 but carry proprietary 12V bidirectional balanced mic signal, not Ethernet data — connector id is still rj45 per the given connector list, direction set to input since they only receive mic signal (no data pass-through use case). Audio Output is a 4-pin Phoenix/detachable terminal block; closest available connector id is euroblock. No RS-232, IR input, or video (SDI/HDMI) ports exist on the physical unit itself. Source: Vaddio "Complete Manual for the ConferenceSHOT AV Enterprise-Class Conferencing System" (Document 411-0001-30 Rev F, August 2020), pages 4 (Back of the Camera) and 91 (Specifications).
